what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Mexico by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 390250 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 262411.
Refugees from Mexico live mainly in Canada and the United States.

why.text: The sources here don't record the causes of this displacement: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Mexico in them.
Storms, floods, wildfires, mass movements and extreme temperatures are the disasters recorded for Mexico in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 8000 in 2009 to 390250 in 2023 and stayed there in 2024 and 2025.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2010; UNHCR's figures for this group start in 2022.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 127839 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Mexico people moved to.
